author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists revived ancient yeast strains preserved on Ötzi the Iceman, who lived over 5,300 years ago in the Alps. These yeasts were used to bake sourdough bread, offering a unique glimpse into prehistoric microbial life and fermentation.

Source Article: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40168-026-02417-6
